agent.runner_summary: Runs the OpenAI Agents SDK airline support agent through the TypeScript simulator adapter using one plain string user turn at a time.

log_notes: Agent learning environments should send a raw string in each fixed turn. The adapter rejects structured turn objects.
The final simulation output is the assistant text extracted from the OpenAI Agents SDK run result.
Seat-change scenarios can mutate in-memory booking state through the change_seat tool, so isolate those scenarios or mock that tool when deterministic behavior matters.
learning_env_guidance: Use agent environments for end-to-end behavior. This project does not expose stable exported tool implementations for component-target learning environments.
Provide the user message directly as FixedTurn content or a FixedInput turn string, for example a booking lookup question, baggage policy question, or seat-change request.
Prefer airline-support prompts that naturally invoke the built-in tools: lookup_booking, baggage_policy, and change_seat.
Set either OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the runtime environment before simulation. If both are set, the project uses OpenAI.
